text: Effect combinations. In doeff, effects nest: a sub-program inside one effect performs other effects.
This matrix has the outer effect on each row, and the effect performed inside it on each column.
Each cell is a rule. Under Local, Ask is scoped, while Put passes straight through.
The same two effects, nested the other way around, give a different answer.
Try outside Listen: the error escapes Listen, and the two logs it collected are lost.
Listen outside Try: Try turns the error into Err first, so Listen returns that Err with both logs.
So the outer effect decides what the caller gets.
Scopes restore the environment. They never roll back the store.
Inside Local, key reads inner. After it, key is outer again, but the Put to counter stays.
The same holds when the sub-program fails inside Try. The environment comes back, and counter is still one.
Ask reads the scope you are in. Get and Put read one store that every scope shares.
WithObserve sees every effect in its body, including the effects of the children it spawns.
The observer only watches. What it returns goes nowhere, and the handlers still answer every effect.
It saw Spawn, Ask, Spawn, Ask, and Gather, and both children got the value.
Children under Gather share one store, and the scheduler runs one task at a time.
A child that does not suspend runs to its end before the next one starts, so each one sees the last write.
Gather gives zero, one, two, and counter is three.
Now each child suspends on Delay, between its read and its write.
While one waits, the others run and read the same zero. Two of the three updates are lost.
The Rust scheduler and the Python scheduler give the same results.
When a child fails, Gather raises that error in the parent, and Try gives Err.
Gather does not cancel the other children. The third one still ran after the failure, and its write stays.
side effects is two. If a task must stop, cancel it yourself.
Effect combinations in doeff: the outer effect decides, scopes restore the environment, the store is shared, and tasks switch only where they suspend.
